text:
erin: Heads up — after the last release (merge of PR #4321) we’ve seen ~15% increase in p99 for text-gen on dedicated-gpu pool. Rollout blocked. perf job showed regression in kernel selection path and KV cache hit rate drop. Ops alerted at 09:12 UTC.

jordan: Ack. Can you paste the perf CI link and the failing job id? Also which model/seq len?

erin: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9876 job=perf/text-gen-32 seq_len=1024 model=gpt-open-7b

kai: I can run a local bisect. @erin can you confirm last good deploy sha? We had 9fda3c last week.

erin: last known-good is 9fda3c, bad on merge commit 2a8b7e9 that included kernel selector refactor + batching heuristics tweak.

maria: If it’s KV cache behavior, might be related to LRU change in 2a8b7e9. Reproduced a small perf delta locally (~10% p99) with perf harness.

kai: Plan: git bisect between 9fda3c..HEAD using our perf script. I'll start with `git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad` and run:```
./scripts/perf/run_perf.sh --model gpt-open-7b --seq 1024 --iters 20
```inside bisect-runner.

maria: Add a fast test to CI: `perf/checkers/kv-cache-regression` that runs on PRs touching runtime/* . Also capture `--kv-stats` output.

perf-bot: CI perf job 9876: baseline run 9fda3c p99=145ms; current run 2a8b7e9 p99=167ms; difference +22ms (+15%).

ops-bot: Rolling rollback option prepared: can rollback to 9fda3c in dedicated pool. Need approval to rollback; ETA ~12m.

jordan: Kai, assign me where you get stuck. If bisect finds a single offending commit, we should revert or patch kernel selector immediately. :exclamation:

kai: Starting bisect now, will post bisection script and logs. If anyone has a repro docker image, send it over.

erin: Docker image: gcr.io/redwood/perf-runner:pr-4321-20260304

kai: (after) Found guilty commit 2a8b7e9 — kernel selector now chooses fused-kernel-3 for small batch counts; reverting to fused-kernel-2 restores p99. I’ll open revert PR and attach perf logs.

maria: Nice. Can you also add a test that runs `perf/harness --kernel=fused-kernel-3 --batch=1` to catch this in CI?

kai: Opening revert PR #4382. Revert patch + test. Perf bot will re-run.

perf-bot: PR 4382 perf check: reverted -> p99=144ms (restored). CI green for perf check.

erin: Thanks everyone. Ops, hold rollback; we'll patch and stage deploy canary. Leaving thread open until canary confirmed.

jordan: Will monitor canary and metrics. :thumbsup:
